home.heroTitle: Engineering real products, not demo projects.
home.heroLede: Production-minded .NET engineering, domain architecture, product development and technical documentation — demonstrated through real systems and engineering decisions.
home.engineeringTitle: Architecture is visible in the work.
home.docsTitle: Documentation is part of the engineering output.
home.docsBody: YARP.DEV keeps the existing Microsoft YARP guides first-class while adding curated product architecture and engineering material around them.
home.footerAttribution: Microsoft YARP documentation is adapted from Microsoft Learn under CC BY 4.0. YARP.DEV is an independent engineering/documentation site.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lede: A portfolio of real product domains, architecture decisions and implementation work — presented as systems rather than a list of technologies.

engineering.title: Architecture through working systems.
engineering.lede: The focus is not a CV-style technology inventory. The work shows how domain modelling, modern .NET, reliability, frontend architecture and AI-assisted development fit together in production-minded systems.

about.title: Software Engineer / .NET Architect
about.lede: Backend and full-stack engineering focused on explicit domain boundaries, maintainable architecture and production-oriented software.
about.statement: The goal is simple: make the architecture understandable in the code, the product understandable in the UX, and the engineering decisions understandable in the documentation.
